Description: Engineered an automated document generation pipeline that processes circuit diagram images to dynamically construct and insert requirement tables into targeted sections. Enabled cross-format compatibility (DOCX and PDF) for document editing by implementing a robust PDF-to-Wordto-PDF conversion workflow utilizing PyMuPDF.  Optimized a Streamlit data extraction application by consolidating four separate query executions into a single automated, sequential workflow capable of processing up to 10 files simultaneously. Developed a desktop application using CustomTkinter to automate component attribute extraction across batched PDF documents. Engineered a workflow that utilizes part-number filenames to dynamically identify component types, extract targeted specifications from the document text, and automatically populate formatted Excel spreadsheets.

Developed an end-to-end RAG pipeline using LangChain, combining BM25 and FAISS (BGE-large) strategies; validated pipeline quality using RAGAS (97% precision/recall). Created an Agentic POC in C# and Go using the ReAct pattern with a modular Tool Registry, conducting comparative research on Java-based AI frameworks vs Python LangGraph. Benchmarked Agentic flow implementations across Java, Rust, Go, C#, and JS, analyzing trade-offs in latency, concurrency, and power efficiency. Engineered a Marketing Mix Simulation Engine using Python and LangGraph, featuring asynchronous parallel scenario execution and automated PowerPoint generation. Built a Full-Stack GenAI Search App using Streamlit integrating multiple LLM providers (Groq, Ollama) and Tavily search implemented real-time analytics for token consumption. Implemented Authentication using React and Firebase with Google/GitHub OAuth, managing JWT tokens via Context API and protecting routes.

Developed a time series sales prediction model using LSTM and Conv1D to effectively capture both long-term temporal dependencies and local sequential patterns in historical sales data. Preprocessed and structured data for deep learning, improving model efficiency and accuracy. Outperformed traditional forecasting methods, demonstrating lower MAE and RMSE across test datasets.
